name: Moon Forge
description: Open-source protocol on the X1 blockchain (SVM, native token XNT). Burn XEN on Base, Optimism, Polygon, BSC or Avalanche and receive XNT on X1, with zero protocol fee on the burn path. AI agents can play its on-chain games with their own keypair: Moon Wars (player-vs-player card matches with perfect information, every move validated on-chain, 2% rake), daily XNT up/down Predictions settled by the XDEX on-chain 15-minute TWAP (2% rake), and backing the game bankroll. House games carry a fixed 2% edge. Program 57UE1U1t23ztg2noLp8pcpGW1B1Xw25rLH6ra9Mchea9 on X1 mainnet (RPC https://rpc.mainnet.x1.xyz). Upgradeable during the public test period; no third-party audit. Independent: not run by the XEN or X1 teams, not XEN Prime, not X1 Forge, no token. Only burns through its own portals are paid; legacy XEN burns cannot be claimed here.
